note: Names, titles, descriptions and images were taken from the live sites on 2026-11-17. Nothing here is invented. URLs are stored exactly as published. Entries with own=true are 匡子闲's own projects.
how_to_add: Append a new object to the sites array with id, url, name, and optional canonical, domain, title, description, image, image_alt, image_source, favicon, emoji, own. Set own to true for 匡子闲's own projects (shows a 自己做的 / Made by me badge). Keep url exactly as given. Then run: python3 scripts/build_dist.py && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name kuangzixian --branch main
intro_zh: 推荐看看的网站。标了「自己做的」的是匡子闲自己的项目。后面想到再补。介绍只摘自站点自己的公开信息，没有编造。
intro_en: Sites he recommends. Cards marked “Made by me” are his own projects. More will be added later. Descriptions are taken from the sites themselves and are not invented.
